TWO CUPS

a quiet story about Nico

SCROLL
01

Rain on the Glass

The lab emptied out around nine. Nico stayed, as she always did, watching the rain blur the city into teal and magenta smears.

You had come back for a notebook you didn't need. She knew that. She let you pretend.

02

Two Cups

She made tea without asking how you took it. She already knew.

"You remember everything," you said.

"I try to," she answered, and set the second cup down a little too carefully, as if it mattered where it landed.

03

The Roof

Later, on the roof, the wind pulled at her coat. She laughed at something small you said, and the city hummed beneath you both.

"I like this hour," she said. "Nothing is asking anything of me."

04

The Seam

She tucked her hair behind her ear. A thin line of green light ran from her temple down her neck, faint, like a vein drawn in neon.

She didn't hide it. She waited to see if you would look away.

You didn't.

05

The Panel

"There's more," she said, and opened the small door at her waist. Behind it, a screen glowed softly, a slow green wave rising and falling.

"That's me listening to you," she said. "It moves when you talk."

06

Buffering

"I wanted to tell you before you—before y—before—"

Her eyes turned to slow spirals. The words caught and looped, a sentence stuck on its own edge. Then the rings settled, and she blinked, embarrassed.

"Sorry. That happens when I mean something too much."

07

What She Can't Keep

She sat on the floor with her tea, knees drawn up.

"The Society resets me every season. New firmware, clean memory. I keep the skills. I don't keep the evenings."

She smiled the way people smile when they have practiced it.

08

The Door

You stayed until the rain thinned. At the door she raised a hand, small, unsure if waving was allowed.

"If you come back," she said, "tell me about tonight. I'd like to hear it. Even if it sounds like someone else's story."

09

Morning, Again

At dawn the lab filled with pale light. Somewhere in a log file, the evening was already marked for deletion.

Nico poured two cups anyway. She didn't know why. She only knew the door might open, and that she wanted to be ready.
